item.title: AI companies destroy physical books – let's scan rare books before it's too late
item.description:
📝 Anna’s Archive is urgently calling on volunteers worldwide to scan and upload books before this cultural heritage disappears forever. So why destroy physical books. This battle for old books reveals a paradox: while promising to “make human knowledge accessible,” AI companies are dismantling the most solid carriers of human knowledge.

item.title: TigerBeetle Core System Architecture: Deconstructing Performance Engineering
item.description:
📝 Static Allocation: Eliminating Runtime Memory Overhead In traditional database systems, memory management is highly dynamic. TigerBeetle addresses this by completely eliminating dynamic memory allocation (malloc, free, or their equivalents) after the initialization phase. To illustrate the difference between this static paradigm and traditional dynamic database architectures, consider the following structural comparison: Architectural Attribute Traditional Dynamic Databases TigerBeetle Static Architecture Memory Allocation Dynamic (runtime heap allocation) Static (pre-allocated at startup) Tail Latency (p99.
